mods.name: Horizon
mods.description:
A realistic sky: physically based atmosphere, volumetric clouds and a photographic night sky with real stars and planets, eclipses, comets, aurorae, halos, thunderstorms and more.
Milky Way: NASA/GSFC SVS Deep Star Maps 2020 (Gaia DR2: ESA/Gaia/DPAC) and ESO/S. Brunier (CC BY 4.0).
